scope: SQL bridge implementation and independent oracle evidence; no profile admitted, no HostLab qualification

relations_registered.note: The frozen HostLab Q-series uses unprefixed names (classes, class_fields, ...). The real provider exposes native_* names; the unprefixed mapping is MDD-032 scope. The Q-series shape tests use synthetic providers with the frozen names and column shapes.

pushdown_flags.source: crates/mdd-sql/src/virtual_tables/mod.rs VTB_POLICY, reported verbatim by OptimizerPolicy
pushdown_flags.note: No constraint is passed to xFilter (argv_index 0); SQLite applies all filtering, ORDER BY, LIMIT/OFFSET and IN. No candidate prefilter is claimed.

unsupported: UnsupportedQuery (real unimplemented feature, e.g. RECURSIVE CTE, window functions, unsupported functions)
error_categories.separation_mechanism: AST parse errors carry confirm_sqlite_syntax=true and are re-checked against a read-only SQLite binding; a syntax/binding failure stays InvalidArgument, a SQLite-accepted but unimplemented feature becomes UnsupportedQuery. No regular-expression SQL rewriting is used.

snapshot_session_binding.query_binding: mdd_session::QueryBinding derived from binding+sql+parameters+dialect; execution capture rejects snapshot/epoch/fingerprint mismatch
snapshot_session_binding.profiles_admitted: always empty; no compatibility profile is signed by this module

acceptance.text: 不进行全量 facts ETL 作为默认访问方式，装载或惰性构建成本均在测量内
acceptance.residual_gap: No end-to-end measurement of a real provider's lazy fact-build wall/RSS cost; the logical step/scanned/result accounting is covered, SQLite allocator/RSS is explicitly out of scope.

acceptance.text: NULL、CAST、LIKE/ESCAPE、字符串长度、比较、聚合、ORDER、JOIN/CTE 对各声明方言逐项验证
acceptance.status: 新覆盖（逐方言矩阵）+ 已覆盖（专项）
acceptance.residual_gap: NativeV1 text-to-integer CAST intentionally diverges from SQLite (exact parse vs legacy prefix parse); recorded as a dialect policy, not a defect. Non-ASCII length/LIKE/UTF-16 ordering is covered by dedicated tests, not by this ASCII matrix.

acceptance.text: omit、orderByConsumed、LIMIT/OFFSET 和 IN 下推只在完整等价证据下启用；候选过滤不谎报精确处理
acceptance.status: 新覆盖（防谎报绑定 + 等价矩阵）
new_evidence: crates/mdd-sql/src/virtual_tables/mod.rs VTB_POLICY shared by xBestIndex and OptimizerPolicy
acceptance.residual_gap: No pushdown is enabled, so there is no candidate-filter precision claim to falsify. If a future change enables one, it must update VTB_POLICY and the equivalence matrix.

acceptance.text: 语法/绑定/输入错误与真正 unsupported 分开，不以正则改写 SQL 改变用户语义
acceptance.residual_gap: None identified for the separation itself; the AST adapter is structural, not regex-based.

acceptance.text: 所有查询绑定统一 snapshot/session；兼容失败保留具体反例并阻断对应 profile
acceptance.status: 部分覆盖（快照/会话已覆盖；profile 阻断机制缺失）
acceptance.residual_gap: There is no named compatibility-profile registry in mdd-sql; profiles_admitted is always empty, so 'block the corresponding profile' is vacuous rather than enforced. A concrete counterexample is retained on the error (code+details+ast_error), and no profile is signed. The main agent must decide whether a profile registry belongs to MDD-032/033 or here.
